provenance.analysis: ephemeris-first: independently solved TT epoch, one sample per distinct annual start
provenance.enoch: Day 1 instant on the TT day grid minus the vernal equinox solved from Swiss Ephemeris (days; later > 0)
provenance.greg: fixed benchmark March 21 TT minus the same equinox (an explicit reference choice, not a Gregorian promise)
provenance.limits: the ephemeris range is computational support, not uniform astronomical accuracy; this TT grid is separate from site sunrise views
